findings.message: 86% of elements share a left edge with another (18 alignment columns, 23 one-offs)
Inconsistent vertical rhythm — gap coefficient of variation 0.82 (median 33px, σ 42px across 20 pairs)
findings.fix: Siblings should share one gap value. Move spacing from per-child margin-top/bottom to a single gap: on the parent flex/grid container.
